description: The bar chart illustrates the average performance of five different methods. The horizontal axis displays the categorical methods in the following order: Standard, Self-RAG, FactTune, CInGS (w/), and CInGS. The vertical axis represents the "Average Performance" on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 60, with numeric tick marks and dashed horizontal grid lines at intervals of 10. There are five distinct vertical bars, each assigned a different color. The first bar, labeled Standard, is orange and reaches an approximate value of 53. The second bar, Self-RAG, is tan and has a value of approximately 54. The third bar, FactTune, is light green and represents the shortest bar on the chart with a value of approximately 52. The fourth bar, CInGS (w/), is muted blue with a value of roughly 54. The final bar, CInGS, is bright blue and represents the tallest bar at approximately 59. The bars are not sorted by height, and each category is represented by a single, uniquely colored bar without grouped or stacked components or specific visual emphasis.
